Dutch Baby Pancake 
desserts from A-Z, the goal : to try to make desserts i have never made before and we are on D for Dutch Baby Pancake. 
mix together all the ingredients mentioned below,  heat a skillet / cake pan , add butter and your rested batter, pop it back in the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes.  they taste like crepes but in a pancake form if that makes sense at all.  top with anything and everything you want :) 

Ingredient:
65 grams milk
1 egg 
10 grams sugar
20 grams flour 
8 gms butter 
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
Pinch of salt 

Method: 
-mix together the milk + egg + flour + sugar + vanilla + salt. rest the batter for 10 minutes. while thats happening, 
-preheat oven @ 200”C
-heat a 5 or 6 inch cake tin in the oven for 8 minutes
-take it out and add your butter and allow to melt 
-add the pancake mix to the tin and place in the oven for 15 -20 minutes 
-take out and serve with honey, fruit of choice, ice cream, Nutella, biscoff 

NOTES:
-If you are using a 9-10 inch skillet, double the recipe
